scenes.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, vertical 9:16, shot on ARRI Alexa with an anamorphic lens, natural light, fine film grain, Neolithic Anatolia around 9600 BC. Prehistoric Homo sapiens wear animal hides. STONE AGE ONLY: no metal, no wheels, no cranes, no pulleys, no text. Physically correct pillar raising: a colossal T-shaped limestone pillar exactly like the reference pillar is being tipped upright. Its foot rests in a socket dug in the bedrock and stays on the ground, its head is lifted to about 40 degrees. Dozens of people pull thick braided ropes tied around its head from the far side, others push long wooden levers wedged under it and pile stones beneath it to hold each gain. The pillar never floats: it pivots on its foot. Ring of rough stone walls on a hilltop, dusty sunset, low angle side view, dust in the air, enormous weight.
